description:
Vital Recorder is open. Your goal is to capture a snapshot of a specific event in a surgical case.

1. Open the case file 'case_0018.vital' located in 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\VitalRecorder\'. (Note: You may need to navigate to this folder in the Open File dialog).
2. Once loaded, navigate the timeline to the 30-minute mark (00:30:00). This corresponds to a critical hemodynamic event.
3. Ensure the waveform display shows at least two physiological tracks (e.g., ART, ECG).
4. Take a screenshot of the Vital Recorder window showing this specific time point.
5. Save the screenshot as a PNG file to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\case_snapshot.png'.

You can use Vital Recorder's built-in capture tools or Windows screenshot tools, but the final file must be a PNG image at the specified location containing the waveform display.
